mapper.sql: id, user_id, link_id, link_type, pm, title, price, balance, mark, `status`, freeze_time, unfreeze_time, add_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.insert: insert into litemall_user_brokerage_record (user_id, link_id, link_type, pm, title, price, balance, mark, `status`, freeze_time, unfreeze_time, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{userId}, #{linkId}, #{linkType}, #{pm}, #{title}, #{price}, #{balance}, #{mark}, #{status}, #{freezeTime}, #{unfreezeTime}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: select from litemall_user_brokerage_record where id = #{id} and deleted = 0
select from litemall_user_brokerage_record where user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0 order by add_time desc, id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from litemall_user_brokerage_record where user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0
select coalesce(sum(price), 0) from litemall_user_brokerage_record where user_id = #{userId} and `status` = #{status} and pm = #{pm} and deleted = 0
select coalesce(sum(price), 0) from litemall_user_brokerage_record where user_id = #{userId} and pm = 1 and `status` >= 0 and add_time >= #{since} and deleted = 0
select count(*) from litemall_user_brokerage_record where user_id = #{userId} and pm = 1 and link_type = 'order' and `status` >= 0 and deleted = 0
select from litemall_user_brokerage_record where `status` = 0 and unfreeze_time <= #{now} and deleted = 0 order by unfreeze_time asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update litemall_user_brokerage_record set `status` = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and `status` = 0 and deleted = 0

update litemall_user_brokerage_record set `status` = -1, update_time = now(), mark = concat(coalesce(mark, ''), ' [invalidated: aftersale approved]') where link_id = #{orderSn} and link_type = 'order' and `status` = 0 and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select from litemall_user_brokerage_record where link_id = #{extractId} and link_type = 'extract' and pm = 0 and deleted = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update litemall_user_brokerage_record set `status` = -1, update_time = now(), mark = concat(coalesce(mark, ''), ' [invalidated: extract rejected, balance refunded]') where id = #{id} and pm = 0 and link_type = 'extract' and `status` = 1 and deleted = 0
